packageRules.description: Effect moves together with the vendored copy in repos/effect: a bump is a `git subtree pull` beside it, and an rc bump without one is exactly the drift AGENTS.md warns about. By hand.
The effect-form beta is pinned to the v4 line vendored in repos/effect-form, and its `latest` tag still targets Effect v3.
Generated code is tied to these: bump them together and run `make proto` in the same change, or CI's drift check fails.
Moves with better-auth exactly: each Expo plugin release peers on the better-auth of the same version.
